items.name: Kanda Pohe
items.description: Flattened rice tempered with mustard, curry leaves and onion, finished with peanuts, lemon, fresh coconut and coriander.

items.name: Upma
items.description: Roasted rava cooked soft with ghee, green chilli, ginger and vegetables.

items.name: Thalipeeth
items.description: Crisp multigrain bhajani flatbread with onion and coriander, served with white butter and thecha.

items.name: Misal Pav
items.description: Sprouted matki usal in a fiery kat, topped with farsan and onion, with two pav.

items.name: Sheera
items.description: Rava roasted in ghee with sugar, cardamom and a few kaju-bedana — the prasad sheera.

items.name: Batata Vada
items.description: Spiced potato dumplings in a crisp besan coat, with dry garlic chutney and fried chilli. Two pieces a plate.

items.name: Kothimbir Vadi
items.description: Steamed-then-fried coriander and besan squares, crisp outside and soft inside. Six pieces a plate.

items.name: Alu Vadi
items.description: Colocasia leaves rolled with tangy besan and jaggery, steamed, sliced and shallow-fried. Six pieces a plate.

items.name: Kanda Bhaji
items.description: Crunchy onion fritters with ajwain and green chilli — the rainy-day classic.

items.name: Chakli
items.description: Crisp spiral bhajani chakli, fried in small batches. Stays fresh for two weeks in a tin.

items.name: Masale Bhat
items.description: Wedding-style spiced rice with tondli, goda masala, cashews and a ghee tadka.

items.name: Varan Bhat
items.description: Plain toor dal with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and a wedge of lemon.

items.name: Zunka Bhakar
items.description: Dry besan zunka with onion and garlic, with jowar bhakri and raw onion.

items.name: Pithla Bhakri
items.description: Soft, pourable pithla with jowar bhakri and thecha.

items.name: Bharli Vangi
items.description: Baby brinjals stuffed with peanut, coconut and goda masala, slow-cooked in their own gravy.

items.name: Katachi Aamti
items.description: Thin, spiced chana-dal stock with goda masala and kokum — the partner to puran poli.

items.name: Chicken Rassa
items.description: Kolhapuri-style chicken in a thin, fiery rassa with kanda-lasun masala.

items.name: Kombdi Vade
items.description: Malvani chicken curry with puffed vade made from a spiced rice-and-urad flour.

items.name: Ukadiche Modak
items.description: Steamed rice-flour modak filled with coconut, jaggery and cardamom, served with a spoon of ghee. Made in one batch each morning.

items.name: Puran Poli
items.description: Soft wheat flatbread stuffed with chana dal, jaggery, nutmeg and cardamom.

items.name: Shrikhand
items.description: Hung curd whipped with sugar, saffron and cardamom, topped with charoli.

items.name: Basundi
items.description: Milk slow-reduced to a thick, sweet rabdi with saffron, cardamom and nuts.

items.name: Besan Ladoo
items.description: Besan roasted slow in ghee until nutty, with powdered sugar and cardamom.

items.name: Karanji
items.description: Flaky half-moon pastries filled with dry coconut, poppy seeds and sugar.

items.name: Diwali Faral Box
items.description: One kilo, assorted: chakli, chivda, besan ladoo, karanji and shankarpali. Packed as a gift box.

items.name: Naivedya Thali
items.description: Puran poli, varan bhat, katachi aamti, bhaji, koshimbir and kheer — the full festival plate.

items.name: Sabudana Vada
items.description: Sago, potato and crushed peanut vadas, fried crisp, with sweet curd. Three pieces a plate.

items.name: Sabudana Khichdi
items.description: Soaked sago tossed with ghee, jeera, green chilli, potato and roasted peanut.

items.name: Varicha Bhat & Danyachi Aamti
items.description: Barnyard-millet rice with a tangy peanut curry — the complete fasting meal.
